pages.title: One Wall of Storage
pages.text: Verify shared access to real containers; barrels and connectors expand the working storage wall.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Storage Tool links/unlinks blocks; connectors extend supported geometry. Locks, slot memory, sorting and count/tier/upgrade overlays are distinct settings. Verify actual item access, not only a link line.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Controller links actual storage via native geometry/connectors; tool links/unlinks and selects modes, while storage_link follows its installed connection rules.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Slot locks constrain types, memory keeps exemplars and sorting rearranges stock. These are not automatically player-access protection.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Tool independently shows/hides counts, locks, tiers, fill levels and upgrades; presentation does not change quantity.
